name: Documentation update
purpose: Change documentation so it matches behaviour, and publish it with a freshness check.
trigger: Behaviour, architecture or process changed, or documentation is found to be wrong.
entry_criteria: The change that makes the docs wrong is identified

steps.note: Update the developer-facing docs and run every documented command.
Only if architecture documents are affected.
Only if user-facing support articles are affected.
Review, link-check and publish; set the next review date.

failure_paths.action: Fix the doc or the product; do not publish

exit_criteria: Every command shown was run and works
Owner and next review date recorded
communication_plan: Announce material changes in the engineering channel.
